notes.title: V1.01 - More maps Update!
notes.notes:
V1.01
Hey everyone!

Here are some fixes and improvements to last v1.01 release.

Improvements:
- 5 new maps on Get All Colors mode
- 5 new maps on Last Standing mode
- New options menu 

As always, please continue to post your bug reports and feedback in the Discussions area of the Community Hub

notes.title: V0.30
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Here are some fixes and improvements to last week v0.30 release.

Thanks to the curators, youtubers and reviewers who gave us some great feedbacks.

Fixes:
- Delay on Start time after restart
- Broken animations and sfxs

Improvements:
- Support for Linux
- Fast restart with "R" on keyboard and "R1" on control
- 5 new maps on Get All Colors mode
- 10 new maps on Last Standing mode
- 2 new teleporter mechanics for both modes
- Animations in general were optimized and improved visually

As always, please continue to post your bug reports and feedback in the Discussions area of the Community Hub

notes.title: V0.20
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Here are some fixes and improvements to last week v0.20 release.

Thanks to the curators, youtubers and reviewers who gave us some great feedbacks.

Fixes:
- Last Standing mode: fix in high end pc where it was possible to walk over holes
- Fixed broken animations

Improvements:
- Animations in general were optimized and improved visually
- Spectrum animation of the music is bothering some people, the glow has been decreased and the frequency improved
- Added support for languages: Russian, German, Turkish and Portuguese

As always, please continue to post your bug reports and feedback in the Discussions area of the Community Hub
